## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes in `backend/` (and `frontend/` if touched)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes in `backend/` and `frontend/`
- [ ] `npm run build` passes in `frontend/` (if the UI changed)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real personal data are committed (`.env` files stay local, only `.env.example` is tracked)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`, `.env.example`, `database/schema.sql` notes) where relevant
- [ ] New endpoints enforce authentication and scope every query by `user_id`
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording attached for UI changes
